title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the ruins of your enemies.
pitch: Step into the role of a Titan AI, maneuvering a compact salvage mech to dismantle enemies and reclaim your power. Engage in tactical combat where every decision impacts your survival and capabilities.
coreLoop: Evade attacks from enemies while identifying and targeting their subsystems. Defeat them to secure components that allow for immediate tactical decisions.

mechanics.name: Tactical Dismantling
mechanics.description: Players can choose how to defeat enemies based on their visible subsystems, affecting the loot gained.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players must quickly choose to install, secure, or dismantle the salvaged component.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, E to interact
controls.mouse: Aim with mouse, left click to attack

artDirection.backgroundFx: faint moving silhouettes of larger machines

difficulty.start: Introduce the telegraphed attack patterns of the enemy with slow speed.
difficulty.progression: Increase the frequency and complexity of enemy telegraphs as health decreases.
difficulty.peak: Players face a final decision point where their survival choices dramatically impact the outcome.

winLose.win: Successfully extract a usable component and escape the arena.
winLose.lose: Deplete your core integrity through enemy attacks without successfully salvaging.

juice.screenShake: when the player successfully evades an attack
juice.particles: when an enemy is dismantled or a component is extracted
juice.hitStop: when the player hits an enemy's subsystem
juice.flash: when the player makes a decision on the salvaged component

scopeNotes: No procedural dungeons, economy/shop, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, upgrades between runs, narrative scenes beyond one line of flavor text, or save systems beyond engine defaults.

scoreEvents: score increases on evasion, subsystem hits, successful dismantling, and component decisions
